text.en: One last thing. Stories tend to skip the part where the hero remembers to pack bandages.
text.zh-CN: 还有件事。故事往往省掉英雄出门前，想起来带绷带的那一段。

text.en: That sounds suspiciously like an errand.
text.zh-CN: 这话听着，很像要让我跑腿。

text.en: A short one, with supplies and lessons attached. Or you may choose a school and set out at once.
text.zh-CN: 一趟短差，附带补给和几堂课。你也可以直接选择学派，独自上路。

text.en: All right. What does a properly packed hero need?
text.zh-CN: 好吧，一个准备充分的英雄需要什么？

text.en: Start with 300 silver. Try not to mistake the budget for a reward.
text.zh-CN: 先给你三百银币。别急着高兴，这是经费，不是奖金。

text.en: Go to Crossroads, then the Supply Shop. Bring back five Restorative Tonics.
text.zh-CN: 去十字镇的补给铺，带回五份恢复药剂。

text.en: Five? Are you expecting a particularly educational afternoon?
text.zh-CN: 五份？你预料我今天能学到不少惨痛教训？

text.en: I prefer to call it preparation. Ask the shopkeeper about beginner supplies before spending anything.
text.zh-CN: 我更愿意称之为有备无患。掏钱之前，先问问店主有没有新手补给。

text.en: Your journal keeps the task and destination. Consult it whenever a dramatic speech drives out the useful details.
text.zh-CN: 任务和目的地都记在日志里。听完豪言壮语，忘了正事的时候，就翻翻。

text.en: Crossroads, Supply Shop, five tonics. I even remembered the useful part.
text.zh-CN: 十字镇，补给铺，五份药剂。我竟然记住重点了。

text.en: Grimm sent you? Excellent. I have a beginner's scroll for you. Choose a fighting style before you choose a heroic pose.
text.zh-CN: 格林让你来的？正好，我这里有本新手卷轴送你。先选打法，再选英雄的站姿。

text.en: A free lesson? I was warned shops were dangerous.
text.zh-CN: 免费送卷轴？我还听说，商店是很危险的地方。

text.en: Only for your purse. Take five Restorative Tonics as well; this batch is part of the starter allowance.
text.zh-CN: 主要是对钱袋危险。这五份恢复药剂也拿着，算在新手补给里。

text.en: There. Grimm gets his proof of preparation, you keep the travel money, and I gain a customer who might come back alive.
text.zh-CN: 这样，格林知道你准备过了，你留下路费，我多一个有机会活着回头的顾客。

text.en: At last, a business plan with my interests in it.
text.zh-CN: 终于，有份生意计划考虑到我的利益了。

text.en: Five tonics, all accounted for. Back to Grimm's home before I spend the budget on a magnificent hat.
text.zh-CN: 五份药剂齐了。回格林居所复命，免得我把经费花在一顶气派的帽子上。

text.en: Supplies secured. Good. Being prepared gives an adventure a much better chance of reaching its second chapter.
text.zh-CN: 补给齐了，很好。准备充分，故事才更有机会写到第二章。

text.en: Keep recovery items close and check their effects before using them. Pride is a poor substitute for medicine.
text.zh-CN: 恢复用品别放太远，用前看清效果。自尊心可代替不了药。

text.en: I had noticed its disappointing medical properties.
text.zh-CN: 我已经发现，自尊心的药效不太理想了。

text.en: Now, a practical choice: a friendly bout with the young apprentice in Crossroads, or a confrontation with the road bully in Rainmarket.
text.zh-CN: 接下来选一项实地练习：去十字镇和小学徒友好切磋，或去雨集镇挑战拦路的恶霸。

text.en: I suspect those are not equally difficult.
text.zh-CN: 我怀疑，这两项的难度不太一样。

text.en: Correct. The apprentice teaches timing. The bully teaches the value of returning later.
text.zh-CN: 没错。学徒教你掌握时机，恶霸教你明白什么叫改日再来。

text.en: The apprentice, please. I would like a lesson with fewer teeth involved.
text.zh-CN: 我选学徒。我希望这堂课，尽量不涉及牙齿的损失。

text.en: A sensible choice. Agree on a practice bout, then report back.
text.zh-CN: 稳妥。约好切磋的规矩，结束后回来找我。

text.en: You will find the young apprentice in Crossroads. A practice bout, remember. We are training a traveller, not a menace.
text.zh-CN: 小学徒就在十字镇。记住，是友好切磋。我在培养旅人，不是制造麻烦。

text.en: You must be Grimm's traveller. Ready for a practice bout? We stop when someone yields.
text.zh-CN: 你就是格林说的旅人？来练一场吧，谁认输就停。

text.en: Agreed. I shall attempt to look experienced.
text.zh-CN: 同意。我会努力表现得很有经验。

text.en: Save your effort for your footwork.
text.zh-CN: 那份力气，还是留着挪脚吧。

text.en: You have rather thoroughly answered the question of who needs practice.
text.zh-CN: 关于谁更需要练习，你已经回答得很充分了。

text.en: One more exchange. Try a feint instead of announcing the attack with your shoulders.
text.zh-CN: 再走一招。试试佯攻，别肩膀一动，就把打算全告诉我。

text.en: Like this?
text.zh-CN: 这样？

text.en: Yes! That is the point. Now stop looking so surprised that you learned something.
text.zh-CN: 对，就是这个意思！别那么吃惊，你确实学会了一点东西。

text.en: A friendly bout, and a very unfriendly discovery about my balance.
text.zh-CN: 切磋很友好，暴露出来的平衡感问题就不怎么友好了。

text.en: Come back when you have another trick. I enjoy being properly surprised.
text.zh-CN: 练会新招再来。我也想遇上一次像样的惊喜。

text.en: Practice finished. I should return to Grimm before the apprentice invents homework.
text.zh-CN: 切磋结束，先回格林那里吧，免得学徒顺手再给我布置功课。

text.en: You kept the bout friendly and learned from it. That is a useful beginning.
text.zh-CN: 懂得友好切磋，也肯从中学东西。这个开头不错。

text.en: Does losing my dignity count as tuition?
text.zh-CN: 丢掉的面子，能算学费吗？

text.en: Consider it a contribution. This lesson also raises Steady Breath's level limit through mastery.
text.zh-CN: 算是赞助吧。这堂课也会通过专精，提高稳息呼吸法的等级上限。

text.en: I will try the bully. Somebody ought to object to his tolls.
text.zh-CN: 我去试试恶霸。总该有人反对他那套拦路收费。

text.en: Object from a safe distance if necessary. A difficult enemy is not an instruction to keep losing to him.
text.zh-CN: 必要时，站远一点反对。碰上强敌，可不代表非得一直输给他。

text.en: Rainmarket is south of here. Challenge the road bully, then come back and tell me what you learned.
text.zh-CN: 雨集镇在南边。挑战那里的拦路恶霸，再回来告诉我你学到了什么。

text.en: A new traveller! The road toll is whatever you look nervous enough to pay.
text.zh-CN: 新来的旅人！过路费嘛，就看你紧张得愿意掏多少。

text.en: I was hoping to negotiate it down to nothing.
text.zh-CN: 我希望，把它谈到零。

text.en: Then we shall have a very brief negotiation.
text.zh-CN: 那这场谈判，会非常简短。

text.en: Not bad. Unfortunately, that was the introductory demonstration.
text.zh-CN: 有两下子。可惜，刚才只是入门演示。

text.en: There is an advanced demonstration? I would like to withdraw my application.
text.zh-CN: 还有进阶演示？我申请撤回报名。

text.en: I believe I have learned the principal lesson.
text.zh-CN: 我想，主要的教训我已经学到了。

text.en: Which is?
text.zh-CN: 说来听听？

text.en: That confidence is not armour. I will leave you to admire your own importance.
text.zh-CN: 自信不是铠甲。我先走，不耽误你继续欣赏自己的威风。

text.en: Keep walking. I charge extra for a last word.
text.zh-CN: 继续走。想多说最后一句，得加钱。

text.en: An educational defeat. Back to Grimm's home, with my conclusions and most of my pride.
text.zh-CN: 很有教育意义的一败。带着结论，还有大半自尊，回格林居所吧。

text.en: The bully is still standing, I take it?
text.zh-CN: 看来，恶霸还站着？

text.en: Very firmly. I tested the matter.
text.zh-CN: 站得很稳。我亲自确认过。

text.en: An open road contains enemies you cannot beat yet. Train, recruit companions, improve your equipment, and return when you are ready.
text.zh-CN: 路上的敌人，并不都等着让你现在击败。先修炼、结识伙伴、改善装备，准备好了再回来。

text.en: Knowing when to leave is a skill too. This lesson raises Steady Breath's level limit through mastery.
text.zh-CN: 知道何时离开，也是一门本领。这堂课会通过专精，提高稳息呼吸法的等级上限。

text.en: Crossroads, Supply Shop, five Restorative Tonics. Ask about beginner supplies before opening your purse.
text.zh-CN: 十字镇，补给铺，五份恢复药剂。打开钱袋之前，先问问新手补给。

text.en: The young apprentice is in Crossroads. Arrange a friendly practice bout, then come back.
text.zh-CN: 小学徒在十字镇。约好友好切磋，结束后回来找我。

text.en: The road bully is in Rainmarket. Remember: returning with a lesson is better than refusing to return at all.
text.zh-CN: 拦路恶霸在雨集镇。记住，带着教训回来，总比赌气不回来好。

text.en: You can prepare, trade, train, and judge a difficult fight. A promising collection of survival habits.
text.zh-CN: 准备补给、交易、练习、判断难敌——生存的好习惯，已经攒起几样了。

text.en: Choose a school if you wish, or make your own way. Neither road comes with a guarantee.
text.zh-CN: 接下来可以选个学派，也可以走自己的路。两条路，都不附送成功保证。

text.en: I suppose I shall have to supply the ending myself.
text.zh-CN: 看来，结局还得我自己准备。

text.en: Each school has its own lessons, duties and peculiar habits. Read what it offers before joining.
text.zh-CN: 各个学派都有自己的课业、责任，还有些古怪习惯。加入之前，先看清楚教什么。

text.en: And if I prefer to remain independent?
text.zh-CN: 我想独自闯荡，也可以？

text.en: Certainly. Nobody has exclusive rights to learning from your mistakes.
text.zh-CN: 当然。靠吃亏长见识，可没有谁家独占经营权。

text.en: I am back. The road has opinions about beginners.
text.zh-CN: 我回来了。外面的路，对新手颇有意见。

text.en: And you are here to argue with them?
text.zh-CN: 所以，你回来准备反驳它？

text.en: With better preparation this time, if possible.
text.zh-CN: 如果可能，希望这次靠更充分的准备。

text.en: Then take a mastery increase for Steady Breath. Strong foundations are less glamorous than swords, but harder to lose.
text.zh-CN: 那就给稳息呼吸法增加一项专精。基础没有宝剑风光，倒也没那么容易弄丢。

text.en: Mastery raises the skill's level limit across your saves and later rounds. This particular reward can be claimed only once per profile.
text.zh-CN: 专精会提高技能等级上限，对同一档案下的存档和后续周目有效。这份奖励，每个档案只能领取一次。

text.en: You have anticipated my plan to return wearing a false moustache.
text.zh-CN: 你已经防住了，我粘着假胡子再来一次的打算。

text.en: I collect stories. I am familiar with that one.
text.zh-CN: 我是收集故事的。这种故事，我熟。

text.en: I can tell you are new. You are looking at the sign instead of the shortcuts.
text.zh-CN: 看得出来你刚来。你在看路牌，还没开始找近道。

text.en: I had planned to learn the sensible route first.
text.zh-CN: 我本来打算，先认识一条靠谱的路。

text.en: How unusual. You may do rather well here.
text.zh-CN: 挺新鲜的想法。说不定，你在这里真能混得不错。

text.en: I have consulted the stars, the runes, and three very unhelpful birds. My dog is still out walking.
text.zh-CN: 我问过星辰，问过符文，还问过三只毫无帮助的鸟。我的狗，依旧在外头散步。

text.en: Have you tried calling him?
text.zh-CN: 你试过，直接喊它的名字吗？

text.en: Naturally. He appears to regard his name as a suggestion.
text.zh-CN: 当然试过。它似乎觉得，自己的名字只是一项建议。

text.en: I am Eir. My little stoat carries medicines between patients. He has gone missing, and I would rather find him before someone mistakes him for lunch.
text.zh-CN: 我是埃尔。我的小白鼬负责在病人之间送药。它走丢了，我想赶在人家把它误认成午饭之前，找到它。

text.en: An assistant with teeth. I can see the appeal.
text.zh-CN: 一位自带牙齿的助手。我能理解，你为什么看重它。

text.en: Thank you. I will travel with you. Keep your hands away from unknown mouths; I prefer my new companions unbitten.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢，我和你同行。手别随便往不认识的嘴边放，我希望新伙伴先保持完整。

text.en: Then we part here. I have a small, urgent search, and worry does not shorten the road.
text.zh-CN: 那就在这里分别吧。我还得赶紧找它，担心，可不会让路变短。

text.en: My offer still stands if your plans have changed. He is small, quick, and remarkably confident about biting strangers.
text.zh-CN: 你改变主意的话，我的邀请还在。它个头小，跑得快，对咬陌生人这件事，颇有自信。

text.en: My hand is swelling. Something small in the forest objected to being picked up.
text.zh-CN: 我的手肿起来了。林子里一个小东西，不太同意让我把它抱起来。

text.en: Did it object before or after you grabbed it?
text.zh-CN: 它是在你抓它之前，还是之后，表示不同意的？

text.en: I concede that I may have missed an important warning.
text.zh-CN: 我承认，我可能漏掉了一项重要警告。

text.en: Find Eir. You need a healer, not another explanation.
text.zh-CN: 找埃尔去。你需要的是医师，不是再想一套解释。

text.en: A swift animal, a bitten hand, and Eir's missing assistant. That is at least a lead.
text.zh-CN: 小兽跑得快，有人被咬了手，还提到埃尔的助手。至少，是一条线索。

text.en: A creature with a venomous bite. A convenient weapon, if one ignores its temper.
text.zh-CN: 一只牙上带毒的小兽。倘若不考虑它的脾气，倒是件方便的武器。

text.en: I recommend considering its temper.
text.zh-CN: 我建议，把它的脾气考虑进去。

text.en: He is not a weapon. Put him down.
text.zh-CN: 它不是武器。把它放下。

text.en: You have cost me the plan. You will not take the creature as well.
text.zh-CN: 你毁了我的计划，别想再把小兽也带走。

text.en: Stop—!
text.zh-CN: 住手——！

text.en: Too late. He has killed the stoat.
text.zh-CN: 太迟了。他杀了那只白鼬。

text.en: The scheme is exposed. We are leaving.
text.zh-CN: 计划暴露，撤退。

text.en: He trusted people who needed help. I should have found him sooner.
text.zh-CN: 它一直信任需要帮助的人。我本该早点找到它。

text.en: We will give him a quiet place. I am sorry, Eir.
text.zh-CN: 我们给它找个安静的地方吧。对不起，埃尔。

text.en: Stay a moment. Some things deserve more than hurrying on.
text.zh-CN: 陪我待一会儿。有些事，不该急着翻过去。

text.en: You have spoiled enough. I can still make certain you leave empty-handed.
text.zh-CN: 你们坏的事已经够多了。至少，我还能让你们空手而归。

text.en: No. Step away from the animal.
text.zh-CN: 不。离那只小兽远点。

text.en: Withdraw!
text.zh-CN: 撤退！

text.en: Here he is, Eir. Held gently, for once.
text.zh-CN: 给你，埃尔。这回，总算有人轻轻抱着它了。

text.en: Thank you. Everyone, keep your fingers clear while I check him.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。各位先把手指收远点，让我检查它的伤。

text.en: I had an excellent victory speech prepared.
text.zh-CN: 我本来准备了一段很出色的胜利演说。

text.en: Save it for later. He has had enough excitement. I can teach you how to direct his bite safely.
text.zh-CN: 留着晚点说吧，它受的惊吓已经够多。我可以教你，怎样安全地指挥它配合作战。

text.en: Something small has just made off down that path. Quite rude of it not to leave directions.
text.zh-CN: 有个小东西，顺着那条路跑了。竟然不留下路标，实在有点不客气。

text.en: I saw it too. Faster than a rumour.
text.zh-CN: 我也看见了。比闲话跑得还快。

text.en: Then follow quietly. We do not need to frighten it farther away.
text.zh-CN: 那就安静跟上，别把它吓得更远。

text.en: A hidden chamber. I should pretend I intended to find this.
text.zh-CN: 一间密室。我应该假装，自己原本就打算找到这里。

text.en: Save the performance. There is something moving beside the wall.
text.zh-CN: 省省吧，墙边有东西在动。

text.en: A stoat. Eir's little assistant, unless another one has stolen its manners.
text.zh-CN: 一只白鼬。应该是埃尔的小助手，除非另有一只，学走了它的派头。

text.en: Then we have found someone who actually needs our cleverness.
text.zh-CN: 看来，我们找到真正需要我们聪明才智的对象了。

text.en: Pick it up gently. We are returning him to Eir.
text.zh-CN: 轻点抱好。把它送回埃尔那里。

text.en: Your missing assistant. Rather less lost now.
text.zh-CN: 你走丢的小助手，现在总算不算走丢了。

text.en: Thank you. I owe you both a great deal—and he owes me an explanation.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢，欠你们一个大人情。至于它，欠我一个解释。

text.en: Grimm's recommendation? Then you are welcome at the House of Mists. Keep your voice down; concentration is easier without a fanfare.
text.zh-CN: 格林介绍来的？那就欢迎加入迷雾学舍。小点声，专心练习不需要吹号助兴。

text.en: I have brought no trumpet. A promising start.
text.zh-CN: 我没带喇叭。看来，开头还不错。

text.en: We study patience, precision and follow-up strikes. Respect the house, practise properly, and earn the next lesson.
text.zh-CN: 这里讲究耐心、精准和后续连招。尊重学舍，认真练习，再来学下一课。

text.en: Agreed. Quietly agreed.
text.zh-CN: 我同意。小声同意。

text.en: Training first. The atmosphere is impressive, but it has not improved my footwork yet.
text.zh-CN: 先练习。这里的气氛很有深意，可它还没改善我的步法。

text.en: Grimm mentioned a school. He did not mention quite this much snow.
text.zh-CN: 格林说过有个学派，倒没说会有这么多雪。

text.en: Percival. Welcome to the Grail Lodge. You seek training, I assume, rather than a warmer view.
text.zh-CN: 我是珀西瓦尔。欢迎来到圣杯山舍。想来，你是求学的，不是来欣赏更冷的风景。

text.en: Both, if one of them includes a roof.
text.zh-CN: 两样都行，只要其中一样包括屋顶。

text.en: Shelter first, then practice. Strength is learned in stages; it is not issued with a grand title.
text.zh-CN: 先避风，再练习。力量要分阶段学，不是取个响亮名号，就能领到的。

text.en: I had suspected there might be a catch.
text.zh-CN: 我就怀疑，事情没有那么便宜。

text.en: Warm up, then practise. At last, advice that works in both senses.
text.zh-CN: 先热身，再练习。总算，有条建议字面上也很实用。

text.en: The Dawn Hunters do not admit sightseers. State your business.
text.zh-CN: 破晓猎团不接待看热闹的。说明来意。

text.en: Grimm sent me to learn how to survive dangerous company.
text.zh-CN: 格林让我来学学，怎样在危险的同伴身边生存。

text.en: Then you have certainly found the right door. Van Helsing is inside.
text.zh-CN: 那你找对门了。范海辛在里面。

text.en: Professor, a new recruit. Apparently not frightened enough by the gate.
text.zh-CN: 教授，新来的求学者。看来，门口的气氛还不够吓人。

text.en: Van Helsing. We pursue monsters, but our blood arts are dangerous to their users as well. Read the price before admiring the power.
text.zh-CN: 我是范海辛。我们追猎怪物，但血术对使用者也有危险。欣赏威力之前，先看清代价。

text.en: An unusually honest welcome.
text.zh-CN: 这欢迎词，诚实得有点少见。

text.en: Stay alive, study carefully, and do not mistake a thirst for blood for a calling.
text.zh-CN: 活下来，仔细学。别把嗜血的冲动，当成了什么神圣使命。

text.en: Your gear is ready. The first lesson is inside.
text.zh-CN: 行装准备好了，第一堂课在里面。

text.en: Welcome to the Bremen Watch. One voice warns the others; together we stand our ground.
text.zh-CN: 欢迎加入不来梅守望队。一声鸣叫提醒同伴，大家一起守住阵地。

text.en: Is the first lesson singing?
text.zh-CN: 第一堂课，是唱歌吗？

text.en: Keeping your promises. The singing improves with confidence. Protect ordinary folk, practise, and earn your place.
text.zh-CN: 是守信。唱得好不好，自信一点，总会进步。保护普通人，认真练习，凭本领取得位置。

text.en: Urd. Welcome to Threadhall. Before asking what fate intends, notice what your own hands are doing.
text.zh-CN: 我是兀儿德。欢迎来到织线厅。追问命运打算做什么之前，先看看你自己的手在做什么。

text.en: At present, trying not to fidget.
text.zh-CN: 目前，在努力不乱动。

text.en: A beginning. Study patterns, practise movement, and read between lessons. A clever fighter sees more than one possible next step.
text.zh-CN: 也是个开头。研究规律，练习身法，课间读书。聪明的武者，看得见不止一种下一步。

text.en: I am Sanzang. Grimm's letter says you wish to learn. Will you take our vows, or train as a visiting student?
text.zh-CN: 我是三藏。格林信里说，你想来学习。你愿意立誓常住，还是以在外行走的弟子身份修习？

text.en: I appreciate a choice that comes before the haircut.
text.zh-CN: 很感谢，选择的机会放在剃头之前。

text.en: A vow deserves thought. So does a journey. Neither is improved by being rushed.
text.zh-CN: 誓言需要想清楚，旅程也一样。两者，都不是越仓促越好。

text.en: Then let us mark your new beginning. The haircut is the easy part; keeping a calm mind takes longer.
text.zh-CN: 那就为新的开始作个标记。剃头是容易的一步，心静下来，可要久得多。

text.en: A travelling student, then. Learn here, practise on the road, and use your strength to protect others.
text.zh-CN: 那就作为在外弟子吧。在此求学，在路上练习，把力量用来保护别人。

text.en: I shall try to return with better habits, and the same amount of hair.
text.zh-CN: 我会努力带着更好的习惯回来，头发的数量尽量保持原样。

text.en: Sha Wujing. The River Wardens teach balance: yield where you must, stand firm where it matters.
text.zh-CN: 我是沙悟净。河流守卫讲究平衡：该让时让，该站稳的地方，不能退。

text.en: It sounds less exhausting than meeting every blow with my forehead.
text.zh-CN: 听着，比每一招都用额头接，要省力一些。

text.en: It is. Practise with your fellow students, and remember that patience is a form of strength.
text.zh-CN: 确实。和同门好好练习，记住，耐心也是力量的一种。

text.en: This must be the Bridge Watch. Everybody looks as though they can hear me thinking.
text.zh-CN: 这里就是虹桥守望吧。每个人看着，都像能听见我在想什么。

text.en: Heimdall. We keep watch, so others may sleep. Learn the watchword before your first duty.
text.zh-CN: 我是海姆达尔。我们守望，是为了让别人能安睡。第一次值守之前，先记住口令。

text.en: Eyes on the road—
text.zh-CN: 目视来路——

text.en: Ears to the wind—
text.zh-CN: 耳听风声——

text.en: Keep the bridge—
text.zh-CN: 守住虹桥——

text.en: Correct. Attention is a useful beginning. Now earn the right to rely on it.
text.zh-CN: 不错。留心，是个有用的开头。接下来，把它练成真正靠得住的本领。

text.en: That will not keep the bridge.
text.zh-CN: 那可守不住桥。

text.en: The answer is 'Let none pass unseen'. I wrote it down six times. Perhaps seven. Repetition is wonderfully persuasive.
text.zh-CN: 要接“不许漏过一人”。我抄了六遍，也许七遍。重复，实在很有说服力。

text.en: Let none pass unseen. I shall begin with the words directly in front of me.
text.zh-CN: 不许漏过一人。我先从留意眼前这行字开始吧。

text.en: An independent traveller? Good. The road has no shortage of teachers.
text.zh-CN: 独自闯荡？很好。路上从来不缺老师。

text.en: Most of them charge in bruises.
text.zh-CN: 其中大多数，拿淤青收学费。

text.en: Take the Common Folk talent. It will work with your Otherworlder potential when your health is low.
text.zh-CN: 送你“平民之志”天赋。生命较低时，它能和你“异乡来客”的潜力配合。

text.en: That is a surprisingly practical parting gift.
text.zh-CN: 这份临别礼物，实用得有点出乎意料。

text.en: I occasionally manage one. Find Eir in Healer's Vale when you want company, and bring me a good story.
text.zh-CN: 偶尔，我也能送对东西。想找伙伴，就去药师谷见埃尔。记得回来，带个好故事。

text.en: He is healthy again. I can show you how to work with him now—carefully, and without putting your fingers in the way.
text.zh-CN: 它恢复得不错。现在，可以教你怎样和它配合作战了——小心一点，别让手指挡着它的路。

text.en: A lesson I shall remember rather vividly.
text.zh-CN: 这堂课，我应该会记得相当深刻。

text.en: He stays with us. Trust is not something to hand over like a spare belt.
text.zh-CN: 它仍和我们一起。信任，可不能像一根多余的腰带，随便转手。

text.en: Eir watches the road like a healer: first the injured, then the danger, and only then her own tired feet.
text.zh-CN: 埃尔以医师的目光观察道路：先看伤者，再看危险，最后才轮到自己疲惫的双脚。

description.zh-CN: 安静的学舍，研习精准步法与耐心的后续连招。

description.zh-CN: 离开喧闹大路后的一处朴素居所。

description.zh-CN: 寒冷乡野里的一处安静居所。

description.zh-CN: 奇异的水池，旧时招式留下的，不只是倒影。

description.zh-CN: 冬日道路旁，戒备森严的一座堡垒。

description.en: A temporary camp, with stories still warm beside the fire.

description.en: A secluded manor behind a very deliberate welcome.

description.en: A sheer cliff and a fortress with little room for a careless step.

description.en: Urd's secluded hall, where movement and attention are studied together.

description.en: An inn where travellers compare scars, stories, and the price of supper.

description.en: A guarded lodge for hunters willing to study dangerous arts.

description.en: A quiet refuge beyond the busiest roads.

购买物品.zh-CN: 去十字镇补给铺取得五份恢复药剂，先问店主的新手补给。

购买药品完成.zh-CN: 带着药剂回格林居所复命。

教训小孩.en: Arrange a friendly practice bout with the young apprentice in Crossroads.
教训小孩.zh-CN: 在十字镇和小学徒友好切磋。

教训小孩完成.en: Return to Grimm's home after the practice bout.

教训黑老大.en: Challenge the road bully in Rainmarket. A defeat can still teach you something.
教训黑老大.zh-CN: 挑战雨集镇的拦路恶霸，落败也可以带回教训。

教训黑老大完成.en: Tell Grimm what you learned from the Rainmarket bully.
教训黑老大完成.zh-CN: 向格林报告挑战雨集恶霸的结果。

点击左上角玩家头像，可以查看已经获得的武学精通。.en: Open Character to inspect your mastery increases and skill level limits.
点击左上角玩家头像，可以查看已经获得的武学精通。.zh-CN: 打开人物面板，查看已获得的专精和技能等级上限。

找寻闪电貂失败。.en: Eir's missing stoat did not survive.
找寻闪电貂失败。.zh-CN: 埃尔走失的小白鼬没能活下来。

shopping.en: Trade at the Crossroads Supply Shop
shopping.zh-CN: 在十字镇补给铺完成交易

companion.zh-CN: 去药师谷邀请埃尔同行
